subject.title: fix(gateway): recover when suppressed channel secrets are unavailable

question: During crash-loop safe mode, should a successful `secrets.reload` remain recovery-only with channel starts requiring explicit operator action, or may it transactionally restart accounts that were running before reload?
rationale: Current documentation promises no automatic reload restarts, while this PR deliberately replaces that safety contract; code review cannot choose that operator and message-delivery policy without owner intent, especially with two open candidate implementations.

options.title: Preserve explicit recovery
options.body: Keep the startup source/assignment fix but remove suppressed-mode automatic reload restarts so operators continue using `channels.start` after inspection.

options.title: Adopt transactional restarts
options.body: Approve the new running-account restart contract and require exact-head supervised proof covering stop timeout, rollback, retry, deferred restart, manual-stop preservation, and message continuity.

options.title: Select the sibling candidate
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106405 if maintainers confirm its narrower branch is viable and its real behavior proof matches the intended recovery contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit recovery
recommendation.body: Keep the startup source/assignment fix but remove suppressed-mode automatic reload restarts so operators continue using `channels.start` after inspection.

likelyOwner.reason: Their earlier breaker work is the clearest available provenance for the safe-mode contract being changed.
